path.aria-label: HOW OFTEN GRAINS START, AS BEADS
0.48 to 0.52: no grains of its own
Rates with nothing in Density's CV. With Seed latched and a clock in SEED, the left half divides the clock (/1 fully left to /16 near noon) and the right half lets each tick
through by chance (never at noon, always from 0.985).
